questions.question: When the Pharisees and scribes saw Jesus' disciples eating, what did they ask Jesus about them?

answers.text: Why they skip the elders' tradition
Why they work on the Sabbath
Why they don't fast like others

questions.question: Jesus quoted Isaiah about people whose hearts are far from God. What do they teach as doctrine?
When Jesus taught the crowd about what defiles a man, what did He say cannot defile him?

answers.text: Anything that enters him from outside
Anything he says when he's angry

questions.question: Jesus said that what comes out of a man is what defiles him. Where does it come from?

answers.text: From within the hearts of men
